scope: Bounded low-load storage probe and 120-second live publication observation; not worst-case storage saturation or 24-hour acceptance

publication.load: 90 seconds of nice-19 x264 encoding to null, two encoder threads; no generated media files
publication.polling: Nominal two seconds, not a strict upper bound
publication.exit_explanation: Encoder deliberately terminated after bounded load window; not a naturally completed video generation task

conclusion: Historical multi-tens-of-seconds stall not reproduced in this sample. No new performance change justified from this measurement. Historical I/O saturation risk is not declared resolved.
